analysis.summary: A near-white Porsche 911 GT3 R covered in faint grey ink art (feathers, thorny vines, roses) that echoes the artwork on a Monster Energy Ultra can, with cyan accents, a Monster claw and wordmark, and DELS #71 plates. The quiet grey detail is what makes it recognisable.
analysis.feel: almost white body, discreet grey ink detail everywhere, cyan pops, claw and plates as the loud elements

layers.what: grey ink feathers, thorny vines and roses
layers.where: all body panels: hood sides, fenders, doors, rear quarters, roof edges, rear deck
layers.notes: slightly darker than the body, thin dark outlines on the vines, denser around fenders and quarters, sparse on flat areas

layers.where: front fender, rear quarter, bumper corners, sills

layers.what: cyan lower stripe and splitter edge; cyan mirrors; cyan wing endplates and underside

layers.notes: lighter grey on the hood and roof, dark on the doors

T. THIELE with German flag; POTTSPEED on the side skirts

analysis.overlapRules: Logos stay apart. The grey ink art is the lowest layer and runs behind and around everything. Plate text sits on its card. Nothing else overlaps.
analysis.provenance: Written by Claude from 15 reference photos (Gran Turismo 7 renders) on 2026-10-21; needs the user's review.
